digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock IAM grant on gerrit instance role
propositions: The review-bot container needs credentials authorized for Bedrock, but the instance role currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt with no Bedrock permission.

The grant must scope to bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream on Claude foundation models and inference profiles, because the Converse API authorizes against InvokeModel rather than a distinct bedrock:Converse action.
A policy simulator only reports what is permitted for the action named, not which action the service actually checks, so a real from-instance call is required to validate the grant.
Validation must not use a wildcard-holding (bedrock:*) or administrator identity, since such an identity succeeds regardless of the scoped policy and hides authorization errors until production.
The policy must live in a separate file (iam_s7.tf) per the single-owner contract, leaving iam.tf byte-identical, with a negative control proving the Claude-only scope binds.
IMDS reachability from the container must be empirically probed; if unreachable, raise http_put_response_hop_limit to 2 while keeping http_tokens required and record the exception.
